actual_positive_consumers_asking_for_pre.conclusion: No production consumer requests pressure semantics. Every occurrence is either an adopted refusal or unrelated prose. This is consistent with Field Forge R2's BLOCKED_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY disposition for pressure nouns, and it means the pressure demand is documentary and downstream, not an unmet upstream consumer need.

starvation_check.question: Identify at least one terminal capability that would fail if each proposed primary object family were removed (Dva §13 Q14)
starvation_check.result: SATISFIED for every mapped demand without any new family
starvation_check.argument: If the V555 ordered route were removed, D1/D4/D5/D7 lose directionality, endpoints and mediation locus. If the V556 higher-order family were removed, D3/D6/D7/D10/D12 lose interaction, nonadditivity, topology, divergence verdicts and attractor prerequisites. If SDTF K1-K4 were removed, D8/D9 lose occurrence-versus-consequence and continuation. If P06 were removed, D5 loses focal structural proposition and negative/noncomparability carriers. If OBL041 were removed, D4 loses governed order and incidence. If OBL040 were removed, D9 loses typed refusal states and the missing-observability noncollapse. If Field Forge R2 negative ceilings were removed, the lane could no longer distinguish lawful neutral carriers from unlawful pressure-noun promotion, which is the exact control that prevents premature ontology.
